title: Number of Digit One
description: Count the total number of digit 1 appearing in all non-negative integers less than or equal to n.

steps.note: Initialize count to 0, start loop with m=1
Update count: a*m + min(max(b-m+1, 0), m) = 1*1 + min(max(3, 0), 1) = 1+1 = 2
Calculate a and b for m=10
Return total count of 6 (the number of 1s in 1, 10, 11, 12, 13)
